summary: Deduplicated discussion-fed signals: vendor releases (Cloudflare, Anthropic, Meta, DeepSeek), operator friction (agent commits/auth, local resource limits, persistent memory), and several infra primitives (agent memory / workflow repos) needing corroboration. | Cloudflare announces a new MCP v2 and AI Search, Anthropic details Claude Code's development and containment strategies, and OpenAI shares insights on cyber evaluations and model improvements. JetBrains enhances .NET workflows with AI tools, while Vercel integrates Grok Imagine and improves its AI Gateway. AWS expands AgentCore capabilities and S3 features. Mistral and Daytona are also active with new product announcements and funding. | GitHub OSS snapshot: several vendor releases (Cline, Anthropic, OpenAI, Qwen, Cloudflare) plus growing infra primitives for MCP, agent security, sandboxes, memory, and observability; missing social/operator reports for adoption and workflow details. | Package-registry snapshot: strong mainstream vendor packages (OpenAI, GitHub, Amazon), rising MCP/runtime primitives, and multiple agent-security/observability packages. No social/operator reports in this shard.
